# Jardin du Luxembourg

> > Official guide to the Luxembourg Garden in Paris, a historic 400-year-old public garden created by Marie de Médicis, now managed by the French Senate.

The Luxembourg Garden (Jardin du Luxembourg) is one of Paris's most beloved landmarks, featuring the iconic Médicis Fountain, Orangery, Davioud Pavilion, Luxembourg Museum, and the Luxembourg School Apiary. The garden offers both free and paying activities for families, cultural exhibitions, and maintains eco-responsible horticulture practices.
